description: Update the status, progress or measured value of a matrix element (objective, initiative or KPI), or log a comment. For a KPI, current_value is recorded as the reading of a period (the current quarter unless you pass period): earlier quarters are kept, and recording the same period again corrects it. For an initiative or objective, progress (a percentage) and notes go to its update log with author and date. get_matrix_data returns the last readings and updates.

current_value.description: New measured value of a KPI (e.g. "1.2"), in the unit of the element. Recorded for `period`. An empty string clears the value.

element_id.description: UUID of the element to update

external_ref.description: Link to the matching project in the execution tool (Linear/Jira URL or ID). Set it once; weekly syncs use it to pull progress.

extracted_at.description: KPI readings only: when you extracted the value from that tool, a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO datetime. Not in the future.

notes.description: A comment for the update log (with progress on an initiative, or as the note of a KPI reading)

origin_ref.description: KPI readings only: where in that tool (a report name, a saved query, a URL).

origin_tool.description: KPI readings only: the tool you read the value in, when you copied it from one (e.g. "HubSpot", "Pennylane"). Pass it every time you copy a value, so a reviewer knows where the number comes from.

period.description: KPIs only: the period the value measures, a quarter (2026-Q3) or a month (2026-09). Default: the current quarter. Pass it when recording a past quarter.

progress.description: Progress percentage (0-100) of an initiative or objective. Refused on a KPI.

name: update_element_status
title: Update status, reading or progress
